stg-keyword-universe-audit.md.title: STG Keyword Universe Audit
stg-keyword-universe-audit.md.description: A comprehensive search landscape analysis covering 45 target queries across 6 categories (direct service, problem-aware, role-specific, comparison, local, and brand). Documents STG's organic visibility (2 of 45 queries ranked), maps the competitive set dominating each category (ServiceTitan, HookAgency, Roof Sales Mastery, The Roof Strategist), and identifies blue-ocean keyword clusters where competition is thinnest.
stg-keyword-universe-audit.md.purpose: Foundation document for all STG content and GEO strategy. Identifies the highest-ROI keyword clusters to target, shows where STG is invisible vs. ranked, and feeds the content gap analysis and page rewrite briefs. Used internally to prioritize the content roadmap.

content-gap-analysis-2026-03-20.md.title: STG Content Gap Analysis
content-gap-analysis-2026-03-20.md.description: A Bain-style competitive gap analysis across 50+ search queries identifying 20 blue-ocean content opportunities for STG. Benchmarks primary competitors (The Roof Strategist, Roof Sales Mastery, FPG) across topic ownership and reveals the core strategic gap: every competitor teaches reps how to sell, but nobody owns the 'how to build and scale a contractor sales organization' category that STG is positioned for.
content-gap-analysis-2026-03-20.md.purpose: Translates the keyword audit into actionable content briefs. Defines STG's content moat and the 20 specific articles/pages to create. Used to brief copywriters and prioritize the editorial calendar for the next 90 days.

stg-page-rewrites-intros-faqs.md.title: STG Website Rewrite: Intros + FAQ Schema
stg-page-rewrites-intros-faqs.md.description: Copy-paste-ready replacement introductions and FAQ schema content for key STG website pages (services, about, individual program pages). Each FAQ answer is structured for AI citability — self-contained, fact-dense, and formatted to be extracted by Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity. Includes documented client outcomes and specific revenue figures.
stg-page-rewrites-intros-faqs.md.purpose: Enables STG's web team or agency to deploy GEO-optimized copy immediately without additional writing. FAQ content also doubles as JSON-LD FAQPage schema source material. Directly raises AI citability scores for the pages it covers.

stg-schema-markup.html.title: STG Schema Markup — Complete JSON-LD
stg-schema-markup.html.description: A production-ready HTML file containing complete JSON-LD structured data blocks for all STG website pages: ProfessionalService + OfferCatalog on the homepage, FAQPage schema for service pages, Person schema for Ryan Groth, and sameAs entity links to LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and other authority platforms.
stg-schema-markup.html.purpose: Ready-to-deploy structured data that STG's developer or agency can paste directly into each page's <head>. Implements the schema types most critical for AI engine recognition (Organization, ProfessionalService, FAQPage, Person). Expected impact: improved entity recognition across Google, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.

GEO-Product-Blueprint-2026-05-31.html.title: GEO Product Blueprint
GEO-Product-Blueprint-2026-05-31.html.description: A research-backed product strategy document presented as a styled interactive HTML report. Defines the architecture and monetization model for turning the GEO audit tool into a commercial AI-visibility SaaS platform. Covers the Diagnose→Prescription→Treatment pricing ladder ($497 / $597/mo / $2,997/mo), the in-product upsell engine, Next.js + Supabase + n8n technical architecture, and a 12-week build roadmap. Synthesized from three sourced research streams.
GEO-Product-Blueprint-2026-05-31.html.purpose: Serves as the product specification and business case for the GEO platform build. Used internally to align on architecture decisions (edge-served fixes vs. phased build vs. dedicated Supabase), define the auto-vs-premium monetization boundary, and sequence the 12-week development roadmap.
